Artifacts

Elorian Stride

Elorian Stride is an Elorian Echo Artifact representing otherworldly balance, reflex, clinging movement, and focus in combat.
Slot Base Type Artifact Functions Binding
Feet Elorian Feet Evade / Clinging / Otherworld Reflex / Elorian Cling / Focus Echo-bound

Elorian Stride occupies the Feet Slot. An Elorian with Elorian Stride cannot wear another Feet Artifact, magical boots, hooves, talons, or similar Feet-based Artifact. Elorian Stride is Echo-bound and cannot normally be removed, replaced, sold, stolen, or unbound.

Elorian Stride Base

Artifact Level Base Value A: Evade Base Value B: Movement
Level 1 +1 Evade —
Level 2 +1 Evade —
Level 3 +2 Evade —
Level 4 +2 Evade +1 m Movement
Level 5 +3 Evade +1 m Movement
Level 6 +3 Evade +2 m Movement
Level 7 +4 Evade +2 m Movement
Level 8 +4 Evade +3 m Movement
Level 9 +5 Evade +3 m Movement
Level 10 +5 Evade +4 m Movement

Movement from Elorian Stride is additive.

It increases all voluntary movement modes you have, including walking, climbing, swimming, flying, wall walking, or similar movement.

Elorian Focus and the Crit Stone Ability

Elorian Focus supports the Agility Ability: Crit Stone Ability. Crit is a Premium Stone Ability with four Ranks.

Elorian Focus I pre-fills Rank 2, Elorian Focus II pre-fills Rank 3, and Elorian Focus III pre-fills Rank 4. All lower Ranks must still be activated and paid normally. Crit then grants Crit(1) to the number of qualifying Martial Attacks or damaging Spells listed by the activated Rank.

Elorian Echo Deck

"We were not made for this world – and yet we are still here."
Theme: Lingering light of a lost world – outsiders between realms, carrying memories, dreams and beauty that no longer belong here.

MASK OF THE FAIR

Trigger: You must navigate a social space where belonging is weapon and danger is etiquette.

I — SPEAK THEIR RULES

Skill: Etiquette
You act like you belong and make it costly to question you.

II — SOFTEN THE TRUTH

Skill: Deception
You bend the story just enough to pass without breaking it.

III — CAPTURE THE ROOM

Skill: Performance
You choose tone and timing. People follow your rhythm instead of their doubts.

IV — TURN THEM GENTLY

Skill: Persuasion
You guide their thinking without force and make them feel it was their idea.

TWILIGHT READ

Trigger: A person, place, or conversation feels layered and you try to read what is really going on.

I — FOLLOW THE THREAD

Skill: Investigation
You connect details into motive, pattern, and opportunity.

II — HEAR THE HEARTBEAT

Skill: Empathy
You sense what they hide behind poise, fear, or pride.

III — FRAME THE DEAL

Skill: Negotiation
You set terms and leverage that reveal what they truly value.

IV — DRAW THEM CLOSE

Skill: Seduction
You pull attention into intimacy and turn desire into access.

Echoes OF AGES

Trigger: You encounter an ancient name, symbol, melody, artifact, or spell pattern that feels older than this era.

I — REMEMBER THE OLD STORY

Skill: Lore
You recall fragments of history, courts, and forbidden names that still carry weight.

II — READ THE HIDDEN LAYER

Skill: Occultism
You recognize wards, bindings, and the invisible rules beneath the surface.

III — BODY MEMORY

Skill: Medicine
You notice what age did to flesh and bone. Old wounds, old rituals, old methods.

IV — TRACE THE WAY IT MOVED

Skill: Navigation
You read routes, patterns, and the geometry of places as if the world still followed Eloria’s design.

UNSEEN GRACE

Trigger: You move or act in a tense space while trying to stay subtle, elegant, and hard to pin down.

I — NEVER LOSE YOUR CENTER

Skill: Acrobatics
You keep control through pressure. Balance, timing, and calm motion carry you through.

II — STEP BETWEEN ATTENTION

Skill: Stealth
You move when eyes blink and noise rises. You pass without becoming a target.

III — BECOME PART OF THE SCENE

Skill: Concealment
You choose the angle and the cover that makes you simply not worth noticing.

IV — LIGHT TOUCH, CLEAN RESULT

Skill: Sleight of Hand
You take, plant, swap, or free something small without breaking the flow of the moment.
